headline: Field watches under $800
stop_reason: Seiko SPB121 has no usable photo: the library image is a 'LIVE IMAGES COMING SOON' placeholder and Wikimedia Commons has nothing for it. Without it the listicle has only three verified pictured picks in the USD 445-795 band (Hamilton H69401930 $445, H69401140 $495, H69529933 $795; prices checked 21-22 Nov 2026), below the four-watch minimum. Needs a real Seiko SPB121 product photo (or another verified pick in band) before a draft can be ready.
